name: C3Mod_Start
notes: Checked flow, NMITIMEN $A1, exit path (S=StackTop, JML $C0:0000), M/X/DP/DB, call sites $3000-$3038 and kernel JML at $C3:0073 against trace and ROM.

name: C3Mod_ProgramTable
notes: Checked 16 entries and shared slots (0/9, 7/8, 10/11/14/15), mask $1F overrun into C3Mod_Init code, JSR (table,X) at $300A.

name: C3Mod_Init
notes: '$2100-$2133 ... everything else 0' is false: OAMDATA, VMADDL/H, VMDATA, CGDATA ($2104, $2116-$2119, $2122) are never written. Name them as left untouched.

name: C3Mod_Return
notes: Sub-entry (RTS); covered by C3Mod_Init's header: JSR at $3023 and SoundReset's BNE at $317C verified.

name: C3Mod_SoundReset
notes: Checked the 5 commands ($85,$89,$F2 x2,$81 Arg0 0/Arg1 $FF) vs Spc_CmdStopSfx/FadeSong, early return, exit A/X, callers $3038/$30F3.

name: C3Mod_WaitVblank
notes: Checked the two HVBJOY bit-7 waits, M=1 need, exit A, callers $3010 and $710F against the trace.

name: C3Mod_AudioCommand
notes: Checked JSR/RTL wrapper and kernel JSLs at $C3:0AE1/$0AF3 (C3_ReadPad, M=0 there; AudioSend's SEP covers it).

name: C3Mod_AudioSend
notes: Checked port order, $0400 polls, endless resend, exit A/X. nit: untraced code likely calls it too: JSR $377E bytes at $426D, $4BC8, $63E5.

name: C3Mod_DoubleRows
notes: Checked ranges $7F:0200-$11FF -> $2200-$41FF, exit A/X/Y, DP $F0 count, $3691 before each caller. nit: likely untraced JSL at $87B3.

name: C3Mod_SpaceRows
notes: Checked STZ with DB=$7F, 63-byte overlapping MVN, exit X=$1200 Y=$4200, callers $544D/$859B/$85A8. nit: likely untraced JSL at $8A8D.

name: C3Mod_CallW
notes: Entry 'M and X as the called code wants' is wrong for X: LDX.w #0 is A2 00 00, so X must be 0 (with X=1 the 00 runs as BRK). Say X=0 (C3_RunScript: M=0, X=0, DB=$7E).

name: C3Mod_HideSprites
notes: Checked MPYL fill (M7A=1, M7B=$E0), $0700 x $200, DMAP=MDMAEN=$80, M7B reset, exit A/X, caller $30F6.

name: C3Mod_UploadPalette
notes: Checked $7E:2200, $200 bytes to CGDATA from CGADD 0, exit A/X, caller $300D. nit: likely untraced JSR $388B at $8AC7 and $8C97.

name: C3Mod_RunTasks
notes: 'C3Mod_TaskReplace (it puts the address in A there)': the task passes the new address in X (TXA), as its header says; fix. Also say tasks leave by JMP, not JSR.

name: C3Mod_TaskNext
notes: Sub-entry; RunTasks' note (TaskEnd, TaskReplace, NmiTaskReplace BRA) checked against bytes ($80 $AA at $39F3).

name: C3Mod_TaskEnd
notes: Not reached by JSR: it pops one return address (RunTasks' JSR (,X)) then D,P,X,B, so a JSR would misalign. Tasks JMP here (e.g. $34A8, $3492). Fix Entry and Callers note.

name: C3Mod_TaskReplace
notes: Entry 'called by JSR': it must be JMPed to (its PLX drops RunTasks' JSR (,X) return); tasks JMP $39B1 (e.g. $34BF, X=$34C2). Fix Entry and Callers note.

name: C3Mod_RunNmiTasks
notes: Checked 8-word list, TDC/SEP before JSR (P saved with M=0), exit, kernel JSL at $C3:08F7 and NmiTaskNext caller.

name: C3Mod_NmiTaskNext
notes: Sub-entry; loop to $10 and its NmiTaskEnd BRA caller checked via RunNmiTasks' header.

name: C3Mod_NmiTaskEnd
notes: Entry says JSR, but the PLX drops RunNmiTasks' JSR (,X) return, so it is reached by JMP (e.g. JMP $39DE at $4674, $78A8). Fix Entry and Callers note.

name: C3Mod_NmiTaskReplace
notes: Entry 'called by JSR' is wrong as for TaskReplace: it must be JMPed to (PLX drops RunNmiTasks' JSR return). Quirk text verified ($80 $AA to $399F).
